parsed.rationale: Both `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/HLSPlayer/Protocol/HLSAVPlayerProtocol.swift`) and `PlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/RadioPlayerProtocol.swift`) live in the same `Playback` package and share three identical members: `pause:()`, `play:()`, and `rate:Float`. `PlayerProtocol` is the more general abstraction (it also declares `replaceCurrentItem:(with item: AVPlayerItem?)`), while `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` is a specialisation that adds HLS-specific members (`currentTime:() -> CMTime`, `seek:(to time: CMTime) async -> Bool`, `seekableTimeRanges:[NSValue]`). Making `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` inherit from `PlayerProtocol` eliminates the three redundant declarations, establishes a clear layering between the generic player contract and the HLS-specific one, and keeps both protocols within the same package with no cross-package coupling introduced. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false).
